latest_reconciliation.scope: Shared type roles and actual golden font weights; all native route families; photographed Shop catalogue, product, search, cart and order review. Generation is not owner acceptance.
latest_reconciliation.data_note: Synthetic records; source-credited local review kit photographs. Production catalogue and media rights were not changed.

latest_mobile_scope_update.scope: Owner-requested removal of device message collection and native monitoring; 16 monitor images retired; two dashboard focus/pressed captures changed. Other image hashes unchanged.
latest_mobile_scope_update.approval: 20 September owner approval retains its original image binding; no new whole-product acceptance claim.

latest_home_layout_update.scope: Eight new Home shortcuts collapsed/expanded light/dark and normal/200-percent text regression captures. Large-text views are scrolled to keep the tested controls visible. Implementer inspected; owner approval remains bound to prior artifacts.
latest_home_layout_update.membership_review: Nine source-generated images change only the Digital card heading alignment beside Share; whole-image difference bounds recorded, compact/normal/wide/light/error/offline representatives inspected. Earlier owner approval does not transfer.

latest_browser_feedback_update.scope: Owner-requested Home discovery, lighter translucent cards, compact match/shortcut controls, premium membership, approved photography, and redundant screen removal. Synthetic widget fixtures only.
latest_browser_feedback_update.note: Golden generation is a baseline update, not acceptance. Original owner approval is bound to its old hashes.

latest_native_role_review.review: Implementer inspected all 68 old/new difference crops in nine local comparison sheets before copying only those images. These regression fixtures do not establish source-native pixel parity or owner acceptance.
latest_native_role_review.supported_roles: Neutral grouped dark canvas/surfaces and blue on/grey off switch tracks with white enabled thumbs.
latest_native_role_review.adaptations: Explicit secondary icon/radio roles, selected blue rail, neutral light borders/shadows and progress tracks remove ungoverned library defaults. Foregrounds choose readable contrast for selected controls.
unverified: Source-native progress timing and complete disabled/focus states

settings_route_review.implementation: Settings grouped content uses existing 24px spacing role. The source shows roughly x24..382 at 406px capture width; native DPR/capture crop are not verified, so this is a measured layout adapter rather than an exact native token.
settings_route_review.product_adaptation: Preserves Settings title, profile alias, membership row, account/preferences/support sections and actions; source product identity and business features are not imported.
settings_route_review.enlarged_text: At 320px/200-percent text the icon and trailing gutter move above the label so Membership no longer splits mid-word. Dedicated test checks actual rendered selection boxes and retained tap action. Current source-native enlarged-text comparison is unverified.
settings_route_review.review: All 12 old/new route pairs inspected in four local sheets; changed margin/role/enlarged-text fixtures only. Selected Appearance state did not change.
settings_route_review.responsive_review: All 13 responsive/default light/dark/high-contrast old/new pairs inspected. Insets change from16 to24 using the measured native grouping adapter; product content/scroll actions stay intact. Current source-native light/contrast/tablet comparators stay unverified.
settings_route_review.control_review: All 16 Settings child-route difference crops inspected: grey-off/white-thumb switches, explicit secondary copy and selected text, progress track and neutral snack surface. Source NEX-010 supports enabled on/off switches. Full native disabled/focus/progress behavior and current native light comparisons stay unverified.
